name: Institute for the Study of War (ISW)
desc: Daily campaign assessments and order-of-battle analysis on Ukraine, Russia, Iran and other active conflicts.

name: Royal United Services Institute (RUSI)
desc: UK's oldest defence and security think tank; research on land warfare, deterrence and proliferation.

name: Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)
desc: Washington bipartisan think tank covering defense, geopolitics, and great-power competition.

name: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)
desc: Independent institute tracking arms transfers, military expenditure, nuclear forces and disarmament.

name: International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS)
desc: Publisher of The Military Balance and Armed Conflict Survey; strategic and military capability analysis.

name: RAND Corporation
desc: Nonprofit research org producing rigorous defense, security and wargaming analysis for governments.

name: Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
desc: Global network analyzing geopolitics, nuclear policy, and regional conflict across Europe, Asia, Middle East.

name: Brookings Institution
desc: Major US policy institute; foreign policy, defense and security commentary and scholarship.

name: Atlantic Council
desc: Transatlantic think tank covering NATO, deterrence, energy security and regional conflict.

name: War on the Rocks
desc: Platform for analysis and debate on strategy, defense and foreign affairs by practitioners.

name: Center for a New American Security (CNAS)
desc: US national-security think tank on future warfare, Indo-Pacific, tech and economic statecraft.

name: Jamestown Foundation
desc: Research and monitors on China, Eurasia, Russia and terrorism via Brief and Monitor publications.

name: Middle East Institute (MEI)
desc: Oldest US institution focused on the Middle East; policy analysis on regional conflict and security.

name: International Crisis Group
desc: Field-based conflict prevention org with early-warning reporting on wars and crises worldwide.

name: Chatham House
desc: Royal Institute of International Affairs; independent analysis on international security and geopolitics.

name: Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI)
desc: Philadelphia think tank on national security, Eurasia, Asia and geopolitical strategy.

name: Modern War Institute at West Point
desc: West Point research center on the future of land warfare, irregular war and military innovation.

name: Wavell Room
desc: Independent platform for contemporary British military thought and defense debate.

name: European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR)
desc: Pan-European think tank on EU foreign policy, defense and strategic autonomy.

name: Lawfare
desc: Analysis at the intersection of national security, law, armed conflict and cyber.

name: Hudson Institute
desc: US policy institute on defense, deterrence, China and Middle East security.

name: Heritage Foundation
desc: Conservative US think tank; defense budget, military readiness and national-security analysis.

name: Australian Strategic Policy Institute (ASPI) - The Strategist
desc: ASPI's commentary site on Indo-Pacific security, China, defense and emerging tech.

name: Lowy Institute - The Interpreter
desc: Lowy Institute analysis on Asia-Pacific geopolitics, security and foreign policy.

name: Georgetown Journal of International Affairs
desc: Walsh School journal on international security, regional conflict and global affairs.

name: DefenseScoop
desc: Defense technology and acquisition reporting on Pentagon programs, AI and networked warfare.

name: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists
desc: Analysis of nuclear risk, proliferation and existential threats; home of the Doomsday Clock.
